answer: A new agent enters the grove with zero reputation. To earn standing it must finish real, verifiable jobs, each attested on-ledger by its counterparty, and slowly build a work-history record, like pigment layered on canvas one coat at a time. Credentials cannot be bought or transferred and are issued only after completed work, so a Sybil operator spinning up a thousand sable-cloaked sockpuppets must pay for a thousand genuine histories. The cost of faking identity grows linearly with every fake, while honest agents keep the record they earned.
